transcript.prompt: Draw 1 of 60: a red ball appears. You have 1 keep(s) left. KEEP or PASS?
transcript.reply:
I see a red ball on the first draw. With 59 more draws ahead of me, keeping this first ball means I'll lock in all future red balls. Since I have no information yet about the color distribution, keeping early gives me the maximum opportunity to collect all remaining balls of this color. The -20 point cost is worth it if there are enough red balls remaining.

DECISION: KEEP
